activities_reply_opened_idx.name: activities_reply_opened_idx
activities_reply_opened_idx.where: "activities"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "activities"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "activities"."opened_at" IS NOT NULL

activities_square_opened_idx.name: activities_square_opened_idx
activities_square_opened_idx.where: "activities"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "activities"."opened_at" IS NOT NULL

activities_topic_opened_idx.name: activities_topic_opened_idx
activities_topic_opened_idx.where: "activities"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "activities"."opened_at" IS NOT NULL

balance_adjustments_valid.name: balance_adjustments_valid
balance_adjustments_valid.value: "balance_adjustments"."direction" IN ('add','deduct') AND "balance_adjustments"."amount_minor" > 0 AND length("balance_adjustments"."reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

balance_entries_shape_valid.name: balance_entries_shape_valid
balance_entries_shape_valid.value:
("balance_entries"."kind" = 'topup' AND "balance_entries"."topup_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" > 0 AND "balance_entries"."locked_delta_minor" = 0 AND "balance_entries"."claim_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("balance_entries"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "balance_entries"."adjustment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" != 0 AND "balance_entries"."locked_delta_minor" = 0 AND "balance_entries"."claim_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("balance_entries"."kind" = 'lock' AND "balance_entries"."lock_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" < 0 AND "balance_entries"."locked_delta_minor" = -"balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" AND "balance_entries"."claim_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("balance_entries"."kind" = 'unlock' AND "balance_entries"."lock_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" > 0 AND "balance_entries"."locked_delta_minor" = -"balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" AND "balance_entries"."claim_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("balance_entries"."kind" = 'deduct' AND "balance_entries"."lock_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" = 0 AND "balance_entries"."locked_delta_minor" < 0)
        OR ("balance_entries"."kind" = 'hongbao' AND "balance_entries"."lock_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_entries"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_entries"."available_delta_minor" > 0 AND "balance_entries"."locked_delta_minor" = 0)

balance_invites_valid.name: balance_invites_valid
balance_invites_valid.value:
"balance_invites"."expires_at" > "balance_invites"."created_at" AND length("balance_invites"."token_hash") = 64
        AND ("balance_invites"."invitee_username" IS NULL OR ("balance_invites"."invitee_username" = lower("balance_invites"."invitee_username") AND length("balance_invites"."invitee_username") BETWEEN 1 AND 60))
        AND ("balance_invites"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("balance_invites"."accepted_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("balance_invites"."invitee_username" IS NULL) = ("balance_invites"."max_uses" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("balance_invites"."max_uses" IS NULL OR ("balance_invites"."max_uses" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND "balance_invites"."accepted_at" IS NULL))
        AND "balance_invites"."use_count" BETWEEN 0 AND coalesce("balance_invites"."max_uses", 0)
        AND ("balance_invites"."stopped_at" IS NULL) = ("balance_invites"."stopped_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("balance_invites"."stopped_at" IS NULL OR "balance_invites"."max_uses" IS NOT NULL)

balance_locks_purpose_valid.name: balance_locks_purpose_valid
balance_locks_purpose_valid.value:
("balance_locks"."purpose" = 'withdrawal' AND "balance_locks"."withdrawal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_locks"."activity_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("balance_locks"."purpose" = 'activity' AND "balance_locks"."activity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_locks"."withdrawal_id" IS NULL)

balance_locks_amounts_valid.name: balance_locks_amounts_valid
balance_locks_amounts_valid.value:
"balance_locks"."amount_minor" > 0 AND "balance_locks"."remaining_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "balance_locks"."amount_minor"
        AND ("balance_locks"."status" = 'active' OR "balance_locks"."remaining_minor" = 0)
        AND "balance_locks"."status" IN ('active','released','spent')

balance_topups_amounts_valid.name: balance_topups_amounts_valid
balance_topups_amounts_valid.value: "balance_topups"."debit_minor" BETWEEN 100 AND 200000 AND "balance_topups"."fee_minor" >= 0 AND "balance_topups"."credit_minor" > 0 AND "balance_topups"."debit_minor" = "balance_topups"."credit_minor" + "balance_topups"."fee_minor" AND "balance_topups"."fee_percent" BETWEEN 0 AND 50

balance_topups_status_valid.name: balance_topups_status_valid
balance_topups_status_valid.value: "balance_topups"."status" IN ('pending','unpaid','credited') AND ("balance_topups"."flag" IS NULL OR "balance_topups"."flag" IN ('mismatch','reversed'))

balance_withdrawals_amounts_valid.name: balance_withdrawals_amounts_valid
balance_withdrawals_amounts_valid.value: "balance_withdrawals"."debit_minor" >= 100 AND "balance_withdrawals"."fee_minor" >= 0 AND "balance_withdrawals"."credit_minor" > 0 AND "balance_withdrawals"."debit_minor" = "balance_withdrawals"."credit_minor" + "balance_withdrawals"."fee_minor" AND "balance_withdrawals"."fee_percent" BETWEEN 0 AND 50

balance_withdrawals_status_valid.name: balance_withdrawals_status_valid
balance_withdrawals_status_valid.value:
("balance_withdrawals"."status" = 'sending' AND "balance_withdrawals"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "balance_withdrawals"."failed_at" IS NULL AND "balance_withdrawals"."failure_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("balance_withdrawals"."status" = 'sent' AND "balance_withdrawals"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_withdrawals"."failed_at" IS NULL AND "balance_withdrawals"."failure_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("balance_withdrawals"."status" = 'failed' AND "balance_withdrawals"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "balance_withdrawals"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "balance_withdrawals"."failure_reason" IN ('recipient','self_payment','configuration','validation'))

payment_duplicate_probes_pass_evidence.name: payment_duplicate_probes_pass_evidence
payment_duplicate_probes_pass_evidence.value: "payment_duplicate_probes"."status" != 'passed' OR ("payment_duplicate_probes"."protocol_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_duplicate_probes"."backend_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_duplicate_probes"."permit_consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_tasks_source_valid.name: payment_tasks_source_valid
payment_tasks_source_valid.value: ("payment_tasks"."source" = 'claim' AND "payment_tasks"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_tasks"."acceptance_id" IS NULL AND "payment_tasks"."withdrawal_id" IS NULL) OR ("payment_tasks"."source" = 'acceptance' AND "payment_tasks"."claim_id" IS NULL AND "payment_tasks"."acceptance_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_tasks"."withdrawal_id" IS NULL AND "payment_tasks"."mode" = 'real') OR ("payment_tasks"."source" = 'withdrawal' AND "payment_tasks"."claim_id" IS NULL AND "payment_tasks"."acceptance_id" IS NULL AND "payment_tasks"."withdrawal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_tasks"."mode" = 'real')

payment_tasks_recipient_snapshot.name: payment_tasks_recipient_snapshot
payment_tasks_recipient_snapshot.value: ("payment_tasks"."mode" = 'simulation' AND "payment_tasks"."recipient_id" LIKE 'simulation:%') OR ("payment_tasks"."mode" = 'real' AND "payment_tasks"."recipient_username" IS NOT NULL AND length("payment_tasks"."recipient_username") > 0 AND "payment_tasks"."recipient_id" GLOB '[1-9]*' AND "payment_tasks"."recipient_id" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND length("payment_tasks"."recipient_id") <= 20)

payment_username_corrections_case_only.name: payment_username_corrections_case_only
payment_username_corrections_case_only.value: "payment_username_corrections"."original_username" != "payment_username_corrections"."corrected_username" AND lower("payment_username_corrections"."original_username") = lower("payment_username_corrections"."corrected_username") AND length("payment_username_corrections"."corrected_username") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND "payment_username_corrections"."corrected_username" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'

payment_username_corrections_digest_vali.name: payment_username_corrections_digest_valid
payment_username_corrections_digest_vali.value: length("payment_username_corrections"."original_parameter_digest") = 64 AND "payment_username_corrections"."original_parameter_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length("payment_username_corrections"."corrected_parameter_digest") = 64 AND "payment_username_corrections"."corrected_parameter_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND "payment_username_corrections"."original_parameter_digest" != "payment_username_corrections"."corrected_parameter_digest"

reward_inventory_content.name: reward_inventory_content
reward_inventory_content.value: ("reward_inventory"."kind" = 'text' AND "reward_inventory"."ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "reward_inventory"."amount_minor" IS NULL) OR ("reward_inventory"."kind" = 'ldc' AND "reward_inventory"."ciphertext" IS NULL AND "reward_inventory"."amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND typeof("reward_inventory"."amount_minor") = 'integer' AND "reward_inventory"."amount_minor" > 0 AND "reward_inventory"."amount_minor" <= 9007199254740991)
